title: Playing with greats and four years at Disneyland
summary: He says he played with many greats and lists the band he worked with for four years at Disneyland.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well through my life I can see I had an opportunity to play with almost all the great musicians. We were playing together in Louis Russell's band. We had Johnny Hodges, old saxophone with us you know. And I played four years at Disneyland. And we had Johnny Sincere, he's passed. We had the great Monet Moore singing, she's passed. And then we had Louis Armstrong playing with us. He's sick now, he hardly playing anymore. And Johnny Sincere, famous banjo, that was Louis Hot Five, you know. Oh yeah. Johnny Sincere, well he was playing banjo. And on the piano, they had Harvin Brooks, used to be Mamie Smith, you ever heard of Mamie Smith? Oh yes. But I was a hot piano player one time, Harvin Brooks. We had a real good, we had Mike Dilley on trumpet. And on drum we had Alton Red. We had a real good band out at Disneyland. I worked up there four years.
